text:
maria: Heads up — small blocker on console obs roadmap. During the staging canary, trace ingestion for /v1/generate is dropping span attributes (model_name, cached) so error-analysis views show gaps. Anyone on eng-runtime / eng-platform seen this? @hao @devon

hao: Hmm, saw a couple dropped spans yesterday — likely schema mismatch after the kernel-change. Which attributes are missing? example logs?

maria: Confirmed attributes missing: model_name and cached. Errorflows show empty model column. Attach log snippet:

```
TRACE: request_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate span=compute_layer attrs={duration_ms:24}
```

Previously we had attrs={model_name:"redwood-2b", cached:false}

lina: From eng-platform side — retention cutover for traces is scheduled for 2026-05-10; we need consistent span keys before then. If model_name is unstable, our rollups will be wrong.

devon: @maria can you paste the ingestion config used by the staging canary? I want to check the trace hook translation layer. If it's a naming change we can add a compatibility mapping.

maria: Staging canary used this env var on the service:

```
REDWOOD_TRACE_HOOK=enabled
TRACE_KEY_MAP=model:model_name,cached:is_cached
```

but looks like the runtime started emitting `is_cached` earlier and our map didn't pick it up.

hao: Ok, I can push a small mapping patch to runtime today — add fallback keys: model->model_name OR model_name, cached->is_cached OR cached. Will open PR.

aj: FYI, adding mappings will alter trace cardinality a bit. Let's also add a nightly job to normalize older traces before retention-hardcut. I can own that if people agree.

lina: Agree. Can we get a quick ETA? We need to freeze the retention schema by 5/3 to test migration.

devon: If hao opens the PR today, I can review and merge within 24h. aj if you start the normalization job spec I'll pair on the retention test next week.

maria: Thanks all. @infra-bot can you run the staging canary once PR is merged? :pray: 

infra-bot: deploy requested by maria — canary job queued. See run: https://ci.internal/runs/6401

hao: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eng-runtime/pulls/812 — mapping added + unit tests. No perf impact in microbench.

aj: Starting normalization job doc: https://docs.internal/ops/trace-normalize — will add test dataset and schedule. ETA 48h.

devon: Merged & canary green on my review. infra-bot, please proceed.

infra-bot: canary deployed — 5m smoke pass. No dropped attrs observed in new traces.

maria: Awesome. Lina, I'll loop you in on the migration plan. Closing the blocker for now — feel free to reopen if we see regressions.

lina: Thanks team, note added to roadmap: retention schema freeze 2026-05-03. :white_check_mark:
